yontem.ne: İşletme web sitesini rakiplerle karşılaştırıp eksik sayfaları otomatik oluşturan ve yayınlayan bir aracı ajanlar sistemi.
yontem.alinti: my research agent scans every competitor in my town. ... My strategy agent checks how many people search each one and picks the best. ... My writing agent writes that page, using my real business info and brand voice. ... Then my editor agent checks it against Google and ChatGPT best practices. ... My publishing agent puts the page live on my website.

akis.ne: Araştırma ajanı ile rakip web sitelerini ve Google verilerini tarama
akis.alinti: my research agent scans every competitor in my town. It reads their websites, their Google reviews, and their Maps listings.
Then, it compares them to my website, page by page. It finds six searches they show up for that I have no page for.

akis.ne: Strateji ajanı ile en iyi arama terimini seçme
akis.alinti: My strategy agent checks how many people search each one and picks the best.

akis.ne: Yazma ajanı ile işletme bilgileri ve marka sesiyle içerik oluşturma
akis.alinti: My writing agent writes that page, using my real business info and brand voice. It adds the towns I work in and answers to the questions customers ask me.

akis.ne: Editör ajanı ile Google/ChatGPT standartlarında kontrol ve düzeltme
akis.alinti: Then my editor agent checks it against Google and ChatGPT best practices. It finds two things to fix, so it sends the page back to the writer. The writer fixes them, and this time it passes.

akis.ne: Yayınlama ajanı ile içeriği yayına alma ve eski sayfaları güncelleme
akis.alinti: My publishing agent puts the page live on my website. Then it goes back to an older page and updates it with new info.

yazi: ARAÇLAR: Research agent, Strategy agent, Writing agent, Editor agent, Publishing agent, Google, ChatGPT, Google Maps. AYARLAR: 02:00 AM (başlangıç saati), 07:00 AM (tamamlanma saati).
